plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 4-date timeline completes: Feb 1961 & Feb 1963 (Ernest McCulloch & James Till prove self-renewing multipotent blood stem cells in mouse spleen colonies) · Dec 1962 (John Gurdon clones swimming Xenopus frogs from differentiated intestinal cell nuclei, proving adult cells retain the full genome) · 5 Jul 1996 & Nov 1998 (Wilmut & Campbell clone Dolly the sheep; James Thomson isolates human embryonic stem cells) · 25 Aug 2006 & Nov 2007 (Shinya Yamanaka & Kazutoshi Takahashi reprogram mouse and human adult skin fibroblasts into iPSCs using 4 transcription factors: Oct3/4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc; 2012 Nobel Prize with Gurdon).
